repo_meta_data.description: Automatic sample-rate switching for Apple Music and Tidal on Mac: lossless and hi-res play bit-perfect up to 192 kHz, no exclusive mode needed. Plus volume control for DACs that ignore the Mac and a per-device AutoEq / PEQdB headphone EQ. Free, open source, macOS 15+.
